definitions.explanation: A book that has been previously owned. Sold at used bookstores, flea markets, and online platforms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古本屋|ふるほんや}→古本屋：16329_furuhonya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しい→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a rare book at a used bookstore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{古本|ふるほん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}えば→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: Textbooks are cheap if you buy them used.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{読|よ}まなく→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{古本屋|ふるほんや}→古本屋：16329_furuhonya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売|う}った→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: Before moving, I sold books I no longer read to a used bookstore.

notes:
Japan has a rich used-book culture. {神保町|じんぼうちょう} in Tokyo is famous worldwide as a district packed with ⟦{古本屋|ふるほんや}→古本屋：16329_furuhonya⟧. The chain ブックオフ (Book Off) is Japan's largest used-book retailer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{古本屋|ふるほんや}→古本屋：16329_furuhonya⟧ (used bookstore)
- {古本|ふるほん}⟦{市|いち}→市：10013_ichi⟧ (used book fair/market)
- {古本|ふるほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧ (to sell used books)
- {古本|ふるほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy used books)

Also read as こほん in more formal or literary contexts, but ふるほん is the everyday reading.
